documentDescription: Use the native Rust port of the React Compiler with Turbopack instead of the Babel transform.
Use the native Rust port of the React Compiler with Turbopack instead of the Babel transform.
content:
This option requires reactCompiler to be enabled. It selects which implementation runs, but does not turn the compiler on by itself.This option is only supported with Turbopack. Using it with webpack will throw an error.When enabled, you do not need to install babel-plugin-react-compiler. The Rust compiler runs natively inside Turbopack.

See the reactCompiler option documentation for details on how to use the compiler.
